summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching its press release announcing consolidated results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing reports financial and operational highlights, including an 11.3% increase in revenues, 32.1% increase in consolidated EBITDA, and a 55.4% increase in net income compared to the same period in 2025. The filing mentions that on March 30, 2026, a change of control was finalized as Holcim Ltd completed the acquisition of Inversiones Aspi S.A., securing a 50.01% controlling interest. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation event; the change of control was previously completed. This is equivalent to a US earnings press release. What to watch is future operating performance under new control. No arbitrage angle.
